name: Club de Detectives
source:
A normal school with a strange rule... Due to a certain situation, you are the new member of the Detective Club. Alongside the scatterbrained Alice Baskerville, you'll have to solve your first case as a detective! The future of the club is in your hands!

Using logical deduction, you'll be able to connect the evidence to formulate hypotheses about what really happened. Ask the right questions to identify inconsistencies in the testimonies and solve puzzles that challenge your deductive reasoning!

[From [url=https://dannygaray60.itch.io/detective-school-club]itch.io[/url]]
